scores.tell: Soft painterly shading is close to real; the roof's orange planes have mildly banded value steps, and the scene has no strong cast shadow.
none. Smooth, soft turn on the rope, gentle ground shadow, small highlights, very like the real towel card.
Flat, evenly lit scene. The target and bear have little core shadow, and the shelf has soft contact shadows only. Reads more as an illustration than as modeled form.
Telescope tube has a hard glossy specular streak and a sharp value jump from lit to dark navy. The tripod is smooth but its shadows are weak.
Faceted star with clean, soft planar light and a broad sheen. The ball tips have fairly sharp white hot spots.
Soft rounded keys with gentle bevel highlights and a modest cast shadow, close to real. The screen sheen is a bit flat.
Water caustics and the sun-bleached wood are heavily detailed. Highlights on the posts are crisp. It reads more realistic and texture-heavy than the real cards, with a weak form shadow.
Glossy, plasticky coral with many small bright pinpoint highlights and a very wet sheen. The purple rocks have a clean soft turn. Closer to the too-glossy lesson.
Metal truss and housing have smooth gradients with a soft core shadow. The lens glow is clean and the highlights are controlled. Matches the real set closely.
Many sharp white specular spots on the cans, ice and cooler. The shiny plastic sheen is stronger than on real cards. Ground shadows are soft.
